text:
acme_alex: Hi, I'm locked out of the Dedicated cluster console for project prod-payments. Console shows 403 Permission denied (missing project.view). I didn't change anything. Was working yesterday.

maria_support: Sorry — can you paste the exact console URL and the time you saw it? Did you recently accept an invite or switch orgs? 

acme_alex: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/projects/prod-payments/ui  — saw it 2026-05-27T14:02:11Z. We rotated service tokens yesterday but that was only for CI. 

maria_support: thx. quick check: are you signing in with SSO or an API key / service account? 

acme_alex: human SSO (Okta). I can list org Projects via API with my personal token but console -> 403. 

kevin_sre: jumping in. Could be token scope vs console session mismatch. Console checks effective RBAC from session cookie (SSO). API token might still have project.list scope. Any chance your SSO session lost the project role? 

acme_alex: how do I tell? 

maria_support: can you open https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/internal/me and paste the "effective_roles" block (redact IDs) or the top-level error? 

acme_alex: got this from /internal/me: {"id":"u-789","org":"acme","effective_roles":[]} 

sam_idp: that empty array is the clue — IdP group-to-role mapping didn't apply. I'm seeing recent SCIM patch from Acme that renamed groups; mapping might have been orphaned. 

deploy-bot: [automation] scim-sync job #8455 completed at 2026-05-27T13:58:42Z, delta: 1 deleted, 0 added, 0 mapping-changes. 

kevin_sre: yep scim sync deleted the old group name but we didn't auto-map new name. The user's Okta groups now don't match the role-binding. 

maria_support: short-term workaround: I'll add you to project prod-payments with project.viewer via the org admin UI. That should restore console access immediately. 

acme_alex: please do. 

maria_support: done — added u-789 -> project.viewer on prod-payments at 2026-05-27T14:18:10Z. Can you try now? 

acme_alex: able to open console now, thanks! 

sam_idp: we should also patch the SCIM mapping script to treat renamed groups more leniently and alert on mapping deletions. I'll open a PR. 

olivia_ps: looping in CSM to notify Acme about recommended SCIM group hygiene. 

maria_support: followup — root cause: Okta group rename + scim sync removed mapping; effect looked like a token scope mismatch because API token still allowed some listing endpoints. Fix: re-map group->role, add alert if a SCIM mapping is removed, and provide a one-click 'reassign members' admin action. 

kevin_sre: closing the incident after scheduled fix. If anyone sees reoccurrence re-open. :wave:
